content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of transient loss of consciousness and brief neurological deficits suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack, raising concern for a cardiogenic etiology. Mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to the syncopal events and potential cerebral hypoperfusion. Although authorization was missing and the claim was denied under CO-197, we request waiver of the authorization requirement and reconsideration of coverage based on this documented clinical indication."}
